response.sql: SELECT ReportsTo, COUNT(*) as employee_count, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Employee) as share, (COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Employee)) - (1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ReportsTo) FROM Employee)) as difference_from_average FROM Employee GROUP BY ReportsTo ORDER BY difference_from_average DESC LIMIT 10
